system.subtitle: Health of the whole daemon: index jobs across every component, what they cost, and the ledger. The graph and search you use live in each component''s Knowledge tab.
system.reconnecting: The daemon is reconnecting — this panel asks nothing until it is current.
system.disabled: Held down while the daemon reports an operation in flight — its answer names who started it.

status.failed: The daemon''s status panel could not be read.

retrieval.noEmbed: No embedding route — keyword answers only.

confirm.title: Reindex {corpus} at {root} — the daemon''s plan first, nothing started yet.
confirm.replaces: This pass replaces the corpus''s derived vectors; source files are never touched.

retrieval.noneBody: The daemon reports no retrieval corpora yet.

build.title: Build the graph at {root}
build.statement: A build regenerates this root''s DERIVED graph rows from the source files; the run is audited to you under a platform_change row.

reparse.title: Reparse one file at {root}
reparse.statement: The file''s graph rows are REPLACED by a fresh parse — derived rows only, source files untouched; the run is audited to you.

delete.title: Delete the graph at {root}
delete.statement: This removes the root''s ENTIRE derived graph — every node and every edge; a later build regenerates them, and no source file is touched. The run is audited to you.

graph.noRootsBody: The daemon lists no component roots yet. Add a component with a repository and its graph shows up here.
graph.runningNow: A pass is running. The other acts stand down until it finishes.
graph.actsBody: Build regenerates a root''s symbols and links from its files. Reparse replaces the rows for one file only. Delete removes the root''s whole graph; a later build brings it back. Source files are never touched, and every act asks you to confirm.

usage.unrecorded: Nothing recorded yet — this workspace has run no counted loops.

activity.failed: The ledger could not be read.
activity.empty: No platform changes — the ledger has never seen a derived-store operation.

system.startedBy: A pass was already flying — the daemon names its starter: {by} at {at}

help.title: What is platform status?
help.body:
Agents find code two ways. The **code graph** answers *who calls what* exactly. **Retrieval** answers *where is this discussed* by meaning or keyword. Both are **derived from your files** and can be rebuilt at any time — nothing on this page changes your source.

### What you can do here
- **Explore the graph** — pick a symbol to see its callers and callees, or pick two to see how they connect.
- **Maintain the graph** — build, reparse one file, or delete a root''s graph. Each act confirms first and names the root.
- **Keep retrieval current** — reindex a corpus. The daemon prices the pass before you confirm; an unpriced route never starts.
- **Try a search** — see exactly what an agent would get back for a term.
- **Read the activity** — every operation a person started, and who started it.

### Cost
Keeping the search index current costs tokens when embeddings are used. The cost is shown before you confirm, always with its state (known, partial or unknown) — an estimate is never an invoice. Totals sit in the Usage card.

hint.graph: Every code-graph root the daemon holds, with its counts. Build, reparse or delete from Maintain. To read who calls what, open a component''s Knowledge tab.
hint.retrieval: Every search index across all components. Keep each current with Reindex. To try a search, open a component''s Knowledge tab.
hint.activity: Every build, reparse, delete and reindex, newest first, with who started it.

explore.cardHint: Click any node to open it here.
explore.hintBody: Type at least two letters, pick a match or press Enter, and its callers and callees are drawn here.
explore.ambiguousBody: Every match is listed and none is picked for you. Pick one to explore it.
explore.notFoundBody: This root has a graph and nothing in it matches that name. The symbol may live in a file the build skipped, or it may not exist.
explore.notBuilt: This root has no graph yet
explore.notBuiltBody: It was never built, which is different from empty. Build it, then explore.
explore.rootNotBuilt: This root has no graph yet
explore.rootNotBuiltBody: Nothing to draw until the root is built. Building reads its files and can take a few minutes for a large repository.
explore.noNode: The daemon answered found with no symbol to draw.
explore.unknownState: The daemon answered "{state}" — this page predates it.
explore.pathHintBody: Type the names of two symbols and the path between them is drawn here.
explore.pathStateBody: There is no path to draw for that answer.
